user.title: Svitlobot Validator
user.description: Watch a Svitlobot Telegram channel and check its posts against a voltage meter powered from the grid (e.g. before the inverter). Verdicts go to another chat; problems on your side (the grid is fine but Svitlobot says it's gone) also go to you privately. The bot must be an admin of both channels.

data_description.token: From @BotFather. The bot reads the Svitlobot channel and posts the verdicts.
data_description.source_chat: Chat id (-100…) or @username of the channel Svitlobot posts to.
data_description.target_chat: Chat id (-100…) or @username of the chat that gets the verdicts.
data_description.voltage_entity: Voltage of a meter powered straight from the grid (e.g. before the inverter). While it keeps reporting, the grid is physically there; it alone decides.
data_description.voltage_min: Usually the inverter's lowest accepted grid voltage.
data_description.voltage_max: Usually the inverter's highest accepted grid voltage.
data_description.fresh_seconds: The meter is considered powered while its last report is at most this old.
data_description.owner_chat: Optional. Your Telegram user id (or @username). Press Start in the bot first, otherwise it can't message you. You get a note when the grid is fine but Svitlobot reports an outage (a pinger or Svitlobot glitch).
data_description.pinger_entity: Optional. Binary sensor that is on while the device pinging Svitlobot is reachable; its state goes into the private note.

error.chat_not_found: The bot can't see this chat. Add it to the chat (as an admin for channels).
error.same_chat: Use a different chat than the Svitlobot channel.
error.bad_range: Must be higher than the lowest acceptable voltage.

abort.already_configured: This Svitlobot channel is already watched.
